item.title: Bulletin updated at 16:30 HKT 27/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
With the anticyclone aloft over the western North Pacific extending westwards, the weather will improve gradually over the coast of southern China in the next couple of days. A hot southwesterly airstream will persist and bring a few showers to the region next week. The anticyclone aloft covering southern China is expected to weaken in the latter part of next week.

Date/Month: 28/05 (Saturday)
Wind: South force 3 to 4.
Weather: Cloudy with a few showers and thunderstorms. Showers will be heavier over some areas in the morning. Showers will ease off with sunny intervals in the afternoon.
Temp range: 26 - 30 C
R.H. range: 70 - 95 per Cent
PSR: High
